title: Downloading reports
summary: Every list can be downloaded as a CSV file for Excel or Google Sheets, and a PO as Excel, PDF or CSV.

blocks.text: Look for **Download CSV** on Items Sold, Open Checks, Reconciliation, Invoices without a logged purchase, the purchase log, every Fix Issues list and every Inventory Report. Items Sold also has **Download sales data**: every line item sold, as CSV or PDF. A purchase order has **Download** with a menu: **Excel**, **PDF** or **CSV**. It is on each vendor in the cart, in Send PO, on each order in Placed Orders and in Recent PO sends.
Tap the download icon at the top right of a report. A preview opens with Share and Save.

items: The download always has the **whole list** for the dates you picked, not only the rows your search or sort shows.
On Fix Issues it is the whole Open or Closed list you are on.
The button is greyed out while the report loads or when it is empty.
People with Hide sales numbers don't get sales downloads, and check totals are left blank for them.

blocks.text: CSV cells that look like formulas are made safe, so a file opens in Excel without running anything.
